issues.span: Their words bring great joy and good results.
issues.evidence: Dharma 'producing supreme noble bliss and attaining its fruit' (the practice yields noble bliss and its fruit); not that the words bring joy
issues.fix: Following it brings noble joy and its good results.
without losing heart or being afraid

issues.span: Others do not practice in form
issues.evidence: 'Whoever does not practice in form...' refers to the same bodhisattva type described; 'Others' wrongly suggests a different group
issues.fix: Whoever does not practice in form, feeling, idea, or intention

issues.span: They truly understand that not practicing is the real practice.
issues.evidence: 'Because they thoroughly understand that non-practice is the practice': the understanding is the reason they practice the wisdom of the Sugatas; 'real' is added
issues.fix: They practice the wisdom of the Well-Gone Ones because they fully understand that not practicing is the practice.

issues.span: the awakening of a Victorious One
issues.fix: the awakening of the Victorious Ones, which is free of clinging

issues.evidence: 'tens of millions of heads of a large crowd of people'
issues.fix: cuts off millions of heads from a huge crowd

issues.evidence: beings are known 'to be like emanations' (conjured appearances), not 'illusion' (sgyu ma)

issues.span: You must enter into awakening this way
issues.evidence: 'Entering into awakening in this way without a discouraged mind, this is the supreme armor' (a description, not a command)
issues.fix: Entering into awakening this way without losing heart is the best armor for holy persons.

issues.span: only imagines a self and living beings
issues.evidence: 'a bodhisattva who conceptualizes self and sentient beings' (clings to them as real); 'only imagines' may suggest beings do not exist at all
issues.fix: who holds on to the idea of a self and of living beings
